        function attachLoginValidation() {

            const emailMin = parseInt(emailComp?.getAttribute('minlength') || '0', 10);
            const emailMax = parseInt(emailComp?.getAttribute('maxlength') || '9999', 10);

            let attempts = 0;
            const poll = setInterval(function () {

                if (!emailInput) {

                    return;
                }
                clearInterval(poll);
                if (!emailInput._loginWired) {
                    emailInput._loginWired = true;

        function attachRegisterValidation() {
            function limits(selector) {
                const el = document.querySelector(selector);
                return {
                    min: parseInt(el?.getAttribute('minlength') || '0', 10),
                    max: parseInt(el?.getAttribute('maxlength') || '9999', 10),
                };
            }

            const nameLimits  = limits('acsl-input-fields#regName');
            const emailLimits = limits('acsl-input-fields#regEmail');
            const phoneLimits = limits('acsl-input-fields#regPhone');

            function wireTextInput(input, errorId, minV, maxV, validator, lettersOnlyMode, noSpaceMode) {
                if (!input || input._regTextWired) return;
                input._regTextWired = true;
                input.setAttribute('maxlength', maxV);
                if (lettersOnlyMode) {
                    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                        const allowed = ['Backspace', 'Delete', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Tab', 'Home', 'End'];
                        if (allowed.includes(e.key)) return;
                        if (e.key === ' ') {
                            if (this.value.length === 0 || this.value.slice(-1) === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); return; }
                            return;
                        }
                        if (!/^[A-Za-z\s]$/.test(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
                    });
                    input.addEventListener('blur', function () { this.value = this.value.trim(); });
                }
                if (noSpaceMode) {
                    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                        if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
                    });
                }
                input.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    if (this.value.length > 0) validator(this.value.trim(), minV, maxV);
                    else showError(errorId, '');
                });
            }

            function wirePhoneInput(input) {
                if (!input || input._regPhoneWired) return;
                input._regPhoneWired = true;
                input.setAttribute('maxlength', phoneLimits.max);
                input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    const allowed = ['Backspace', 'Delete', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Tab', 'Home', 'End'];
                    if (allowed.includes(e.key)) return;
                    if (!/^\d$/.test(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
                });
                input.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, phoneLimits.max);
                    if (this.value.length > 0) validateRegPhone(this.value, phoneLimits.min, phoneLimits.max);
                    else showError('regPhoneError', '');
                });
            }

            let attempts = 0;
            const poll = setInterval(function () {
                attempts++;
                const allReady = [
                    document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regName')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'),
                    document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regEmail')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'),
                    document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regPhone')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'),
                ].every(Boolean);

                if (!allReady) {
                    if (attempts >= 80) clearInterval(poll);
                    return;
                }

                clearInterval(poll);

                wireTextInput(document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regName')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'), 'regNameError', nameLimits.min, nameLimits.max, validateRegName, true, false);
                wireTextInput(document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regEmail')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'), 'regEmailError', emailLimits.min, emailLimits.max, validateRegEmail, false, true);
                wirePhoneInput(document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#regPhone')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input'));

                ['regName', 'regEmail', 'regPhone'].forEach(function (id) {
                    const inp = document.querySelector('acsl-input-fields#' + id)?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('input');
                    if (inp) inp.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('regSendOtpBtn').click(); }
                    });
                });
            }, 50);
        }

        function initModalOtpBoxes() {
            const boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.modal-otp-box'));
            boxes.forEach(function (box, idx) {
                box.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
                        if (box.value) { box.value = ''; box.classList.remove('modal-otp-filled'); }
                        else if (idx > 0) { boxes[idx - 1].focus(); boxes[idx - 1].value = ''; boxes[idx - 1].classList.remove('modal-otp-filled'); }
                        e.preventDefault();
                    }
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft'  && idx > 0)              { boxes[idx - 1].focus(); e.preventDefault(); }
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && idx < boxes.length-1) { boxes[idx + 1].focus(); e.preventDefault(); }
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        if (box.closest('#loginStep2')) document.getElementById('modalVerifyOtpBtn').click();
                        if (box.closest('#regStep2'))   document.getElementById('regVerifyOtpBtn').click();
                    }
                });
                box.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    const val = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-1);
                    this.value = val;
                    this.classList.toggle('modal-otp-filled', !!val);
                    this.classList.remove('modal-otp-error-box');
                    if (val && idx < boxes.length - 1) boxes[idx + 1].focus();
                    if (this.closest('#loginStep2')) showError('modalOtpError', '');
                    if (this.closest('#regStep2'))   showError('regOtpError', '');
                });
                box.addEventListener('paste', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const pasted = (e.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData('text').replace(/\D/g, '');
                    if (!pasted) return;
                    const containerBoxes = Array.from(box.closest('.modal-otp-boxes').querySelectorAll('.modal-otp-box'));
                    containerBoxes.forEach(function (b, i) {
                        b.value = pasted[i] || '';
                        b.classList.toggle('modal-otp-filled', !!b.value);
                        b.classList.remove('modal-otp-error-box');
                    });
                    containerBoxes[Math.min(pasted.length, containerBoxes.length - 1)].focus();
                    if (box.closest('#loginStep2')) showError('modalOtpError', '');
                    if (box.closest('#regStep2'))   showError('regOtpError', '');
                });
            });
        }

/* ── Global userAuthenticated handler ─────────────────────────────────────
   Runs on every page after modal login/register.
   Converts all server-rendered guest download links to direct downloads
   and updates their visible text to "Download <filename>".
   Per-page listeners (labour_code, minimum_wages_detail) handle their own
   data-download-url elements; this handler covers everything else via onclick.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
window.addEventListener('userAuthenticated', function () {

    function filenameFromUrl(url) {
        if (!url) return '';
        try {
            // /download/file/{base64} → decode → basename
            // base64 chars may be percent-encoded (%2F, %2B, %3D) by Laravel route()
            var m = url.match(/\/download\/file\/([A-Za-z0-9+\/=_%\-]+)/);
            if (m) {
                var b64 = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
                // URL-safe base64 variant: - → +, _ → /
                b64 = b64.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
                var decoded = atob(b64);
                return decoded.split(/[/\\]/).pop();
            }
            // Direct URL → last path segment (strip query string)
            return decodeURIComponent(url.split('/').pop().split('?')[0]);
        } catch (e) { return ''; }
    }

    function resolveLabel(el, url) {
        var explicit = el.getAttribute('data-file-name');
        if (explicit && explicit.trim()) return explicit.trim();
        return filenameFromUrl(url);
    }

    function applyLabel(el, url) {
        var fname = resolveLabel(el, url);
        if (!fname) return;
        var label = fname.length > 10 ? fname.substring(0, 10) + '...' : fname;
        var imgs = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('img')).map(function (i) { return i.outerHTML; }).join('');
        el.innerHTML = label + ' ' + imgs;
    }

    // Pattern 1: onclick="openAuthModal(..., url)" — convert to direct download
    document.querySelectorAll('[onclick]').forEach(function (el) {
        var oc = el.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
        if (oc.indexOf('openAuthModal') === -1) return;

        var m = oc.match(/openAuthModal\s*\([^,]*,[^,]*,\s*'([^']*)'/);
        if (!m || !m[1]) return;

        var url = m[1];
        el.removeAttribute('onclick');
        el.setAttribute('href', url);

        var currentText = el.textContent.trim();
        if (/^(download|login\s+to\s+download)$/i.test(currentText)) {
            applyLabel(el, url);
        }

        el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.triggerBlobDownload(url);
        });
    });

    // Pattern 2: data-auth-state="user" download links — update text to filename
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-auth-state="user"].download').forEach(function (el) {
        var url = el.getAttribute('href');
        if (!url) return;
        applyLabel(el, url);

        el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.triggerBlobDownload(url);
        });
    });
});

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const setRenderedSize = (img) => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (
                    img.tagName !== "IMG" ||
                    img.hasAttribute("width") && img.hasAttribute("height") ||
                    img.offsetWidth === 0 || img.offsetHeight === 0
                ) {

                img.setAttribute("width", img.offsetWidth);

            });
        };

        // Watch all existing images
        const observeImage = (img) => {
            if (img.complete) {

            }

        });

        // Initial load
        document.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(observeImage);

        // MutationObserver to catch new images added dynamically
        const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
            for (const mutation of mutations) {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {

    (function () {

        function initTabs() {
            const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tabs.labour-tabs .tab');
            const contentWrapper = document.querySelector('.tab-content-right');
            const contents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');

            if (!tabs.length || !contentWrapper || !contents.length) {
                return false; // not ready yet
            }

            function isMobile() {
                return window.innerWidth <= 1199;
            }

            function deactivateAll() {
                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                contents.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
            }

            function activate(tab) {
                const targetId = tab.getAttribute('data-target');
                const content = document.querySelector(targetId);
                if (!content) return;

                deactivateAll();
                tab.classList.add('active');

                if (isMobile()) {
                    tab.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', content);
                } else {
                    contentWrapper.appendChild(content);
                }

                content.style.display = 'block';
            }

            // Initial activation
            activate(document.querySelector('.tabs.labour-tabs .tab.active') || tabs[0]);

            // Click events
            tabs.forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', () => activate(tab));
            });

            // Resize
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                const active = document.querySelector('.tabs.labour-tabs .tab.active');
                if (active) activate(active);
            });

            return true;
        }

        // Try immediately
        if (initTabs()) return;

        // Otherwise, wait for DOM mutations
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (initTabs()) observer.disconnect();
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });
    })();

    var UTM_KEY     = 'utm_session';
    var UTM_EXPIRY  = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes in ms
    var utmKeys     = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
    var currentParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

    var freshUtm = {};
    utmKeys.forEach(function (k) {
        var v = currentParams.get(k);
        if (v) freshUtm[k] = v;
    });

    if (Object.keys(freshUtm).length) {
        // New UTM params in URL — save/refresh session
        localStorage.setItem(UTM_KEY, JSON.stringify({ params: freshUtm, ts: Date.now() }));
        window.utmParams = freshUtm;
    } else {
        // No UTM in URL — restore from localStorage if not expired
        try {
            var stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(UTM_KEY));
            if (stored && (Date.now() - stored.ts) < UTM_EXPIRY) {
                window.utmParams = stored.params;
            } else {
                localStorage.removeItem(UTM_KEY);
                window.utmParams = {};
            }
        } catch (e) {
            localStorage.removeItem(UTM_KEY);
            window.utmParams = {};
        }
    }
})();
